# featbit_group (Data Source)

Reads one existing FeatBit Group by exact UUID or organization-scoped case-sensitive exact name without adopting its lifecycle or relationships.

Configure exactly one selector: `id` for a UUID or `name` for an
organization-scoped, case-sensitive exact name. Name lookup scans the complete
Group collection and rejects zero or duplicate exact matches; it never adopts
a fuzzy or first result.

The data source observes only Group settings. It does not adopt Group
lifecycle, Members, or Policies. Its ID can safely feed either exact binding
resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "group_name" {
  description = "Organization-scoped, case-sensitive exact FeatBit Group name."
  type        = string
}

data "featbit_group" "exact" {
  name = var.group_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Exact Group UUID. Configure exactly one of `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Organization-scoped case-sensitive exact Group name. Configure exactly one of `id` or `name`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Group description, canonicalized to an empty string when absent.
